brevo.previewText: Copenhagen, Vienna and Prague: the winter collection is open.
brevo.body:
Hey traveller,

Quick one: the Winter Escapes 2027 collection went live last week, and a lot of you asked which city to pick.

Copenhagen if you want harbour walks and a bakery on every corner.
Vienna if you want slow mornings and long café afternoons.
Prague if you want side streets and a bridge at sunrise.

Discover curated winter city breaks, and tell us which one you are leaning towards. Just hit reply.

Maya
Vamo, Copenhagen

brevo.name: Winter Escapes 2027 · Vienna teaser
brevo.subject: Vienna in December, without the rush ☕️
brevo.previewText: Three slow days, one café at a time.
brevo.body:
Hey traveller,

Our Vienna winter break is built around one idea: never rush a café.

Day one: Christmas markets at dusk, then dinner at a long shared table.
Day two: one museum, the Ring by tram, and an evening at a concert hall standing area.
Day three: a slow breakfast before the train home.

Lowest prices guaranteed on every Vienna break this winter.

The Vamo crew
